name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd_DVR
title: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd_DVR - 570004 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up only 4% to about INR1,800 crore after a March PVC/PE price shock; management claims ~INR200-250 crore lost, ~INR133 crore adjusted PAT, and debt repayment hinges on government receivables and a Tamil Nadu land sale still unclosed.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +4%, shortfall INR200-250 crore
triggers.quote: the entire reduction, about INR200 crores, INR250 crores is linked to this pricing shock in March
triggers.highlight: entire reduction, about INR200 crores, INR250 crores

triggers.label: PE prices still ~40% above February
triggers.quote: those prices are about 40% up. They had gone up to 60% up, but they are now at around 40% level

triggers.label: FY27 PAT positive target, no numbers
triggers.quote: For FY '27, right, our plan right now is to be PAT positive
triggers.highlight: our plan right now is to be PAT positive

triggers.label: PVC demand returning after April lull
triggers.quote: we have seen demand for PVC pipe already come back
triggers.highlight: demand for PVC pipe already come back

guidance.metric: FY27 revenue, margins, cash flow, balance sheet
guidance.value: better than FY26 on all parameters, no numbers
guidance.quote: company should do better in FY '27 compared to '26 on all parameters

guidance.value: to take to 4 figures (above INR1,000 crore) from ~INR600 crore
guidance.quote: the idea in the current fiscal FY '27 is to take this amount to 4 figures
we are expecting the INR350 crores to grow to almost about INR750 crores, INR800 crores is our anticipation
the retail business should maintain that 15% plus growth

prior_guidance_check.metric: Q4 revenue growth ~15% YoY (per Feb call)
prior_guidance_check.quote: we were looking at overall Y-o-Y 15%
we ended up at 13% because of lack of sales in March because of the shock

red_flags.quote: the backup options are always available about refinancing, backup option about raising of the equity
